apps.title: Seed Man: Sprout Run
apps.notes: Original self-hosted browser vertical slice with tested movement/collision physics, keyboard/touch controls, checkpoint, hazards, collectibles, camera, finish state, and Canvas2D prototype art. Human mobile QA and final art/audio remain open.

apps.title: Burn Buds
apps.notes: Burn Buds is the public identity of the tested two-player hidden-grid strategy game. The legacy protect-the-plants route and machine ID remain intentionally stable for active-room, invite-link, persistence, and WordPress compatibility. It includes authenticated room sessions, hidden opponent state, server-authoritative turns, active-game recovery, room chat, mobile board tabs, same-origin PHP API, WordPress transient persistence, leaf formations, and burn feedback.

apps.title: THC U Know
apps.build: pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r build && pnpm test
apps.notes: Web, multiplayer server, shared package, Discord bot, deployment docs, and end-to-end tests exist. Preserve server-authoritative multiplayer instead of publishing a static-only shell.

apps.title: Kush Kings Chess
apps.build: pnpm check:rebrand && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:server
apps.notes: Next.js client, multiplayer server, PostgreSQL/session production contract, Nginx and systemd deployment assets already exist. Activate through the full-stack runtime rather than static-file deployment.

apps.title: Teaching Healthy Cultivation Grow Hub
apps.notes: Private source contains the academy/encyclopedia platform, reader, sources library, SOPs, downloads, diagnostic center, glossary, and production-readiness checks. Do not bypass production/readiness.json.

apps.title: Bud or Bluff
apps.build: node games/bud-or-bluff/test/engine.test.mjs && node games/bud-or-bluff/scripts/build-private-deck.mjs && node --check site/public-route-patch/games/bud-or-bluff/app-v2.js && php -l site/public-route-patch/games/bud-or-bluff/api-v2.php && node games/bud-or-bluff/test/online-lobby-v2.test.mjs
apps.notes: Self-hosted 2–10 player online party game with six-character rooms, simultaneous server-authoritative BUD/BLUFF voting, hidden answers until reveal, Double Hit scoring, lobby lock/settings, chat, reconnectable sessions, vote-split reveal stats, rematches, host transfer, and same-origin PHP persistence.

apps.title: Strain Showdown
apps.notes: Self-hosted playable browser prototype with a tested deterministic three-lane battle engine, CPU rival, Base/Select/Elite evolution, eight family passives, Focus economy, Garden health, 96-card canonical roster synchronization, result tracking, and deterministic balance simulation tooling. Final per-card effects, balance approval, human rules playtesting, final art, and print proof remain open release gates.

apps.title: Cannabis Fleet Battle
apps.notes: Server-authoritative placement, hidden-state serialization, turns, hits, sinks, wins, duplicate-shot protection, and disconnect/reconnect state are tested. Lobby transport, authenticated reconnect, multiplayer E2E, mobile QA, and art remain open.

apps.title: Terpocalypse: Grow Room From Hell
apps.notes: Playable original The Veg Lab browser vertical slice with keyboard/mouse and touch controls, three weapons, three enemy types, pickups, keycard objective, doors, score, win/lose states, pause handling and code-drawn art. Dedicated project repository remains canonical for future gameplay development.
